hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/placid-lake-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=490&contractCode=MT&parkId=630218 (site 027, Campsite Electric: 'Electricity Hookup: 50') + https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/placid-lake ('40 campsites, including 17 with electricity'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 40 campsites (17 electric, in the Upper and Middle loops) plus a hike-bike site for up to 9 tents. Back-in spurs mostly 23-41 ft; one electric pull-through (site 027) takes 46 ft. Rigs, boats and trailers must fit entirely within the spur.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/placid-lake ('There are 40 campsites, including 17 with electricity, plus a hike-bike camping site') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/placid-lake-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=490&contractCode=MT&parkId=630218 ('Driveway Entry: Pull-Through', 'Max Vehicle Length: 46') + audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (max vehicle lengths 19-46 ft), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/placid-lake (Amenities: 'Shower', 'Toilets (Flush)', 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Water'; 'Potable water May 1- September 30'; no laundry or dump station listed) + ReserveAmerica park page amenities ('Showers', 'Toilet, Pit/Vault', 'Water Drinking'; no laundry or dump), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/placid-lake (Park & Campground: 'Summer Season: Open May 1 - Nov 30, weather permitting.' 'Winter Season: December 1 - April 30 ... Day-use only, no overnight camping.') + ReserveAmerica ('Status: Open through Mon Nov 30 2026'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/placid-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630218 (Booking Window, Campsite and Campsite Electric: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance') + FWP page ('Reserve a Campsite', Reservation Phone Number 1-855-922-6768), read 2026-10-22

note: MT state park on Placid Lake in the Clearwater/Swan River valley near Seeley Lake. Concrete boat ramp with docks and a few first-come rental boat slips; hike-bike site with lockers, shelter and outlets. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 40 sites, showers, reservable on ReserveAmerica with the inherited 3-month window and 1-day cutoff; added 50-amp electric (17 sites), 46-ft max (one pull-through), flush/vault toilets, potable water, season May 1 - Nov 30. Cleared derived laundry and dump: neither FWP's nor ReserveAmerica's amenity list has them (the note's claim had no official source). Fees left as recorded 2026-10-12 (FWP page gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). Note trimmed of restated values and the laundry/dump claim.
